image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small turtle, identified as a mud turtle, partially submerged in shallow water with green aquatic plants and pebbles. The turtle's head is extended to the left, showing dark, textured skin. The carapace is prominent, featuring a high-domed shape with distinct scutes that have a rough, patterned appearance in shades of brown and black. A bright specular highlight reflects off the top of the shell. Text watermark '© C.J.Hutchinson' is visible in the upper left corner.
